statement: The record indicates that while the account holder name was changed this week, the account itself was last changed 14 months ago, and the employee status is active.
judge_text:
NEITHER
The answer merely restates the fields ("the account holder name was changed this week... the account itself was last changed 14 months ago") without asserting the mismatch is a problem, recommending verification, or advising whether to release pay.
